text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1152, 6 Inch Blue Crab Door Knocker in Polished Bronze with Brown Patina

The Large Bronze Crab Door Knocker is 6 inches tall, 7 inches wide, and has 1-3/8 inch mounting centers. This beautiful blue crab door knocker by Michael Healy Designs has a custom finish. The Polished Bronze and Brown Patina highlights the details of the piece while adding a richness that will make it a welcome addition to any vacation home. The 6 Inch Blue Crab Door Knocker in Polished Bronze with Brown Patina comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Available in 3 finishes:
Polished Brass and Brown Patina Nickel Silver Oiled Bronze

Features and Specifications of the Blue Crab Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Bronze and Brown Patina
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 7"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 1-3/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 2-1/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
